ALIEN DRONE — RIG TEST v10

Ankle/foot add-ons removed — back to just the base legs. The back-left leg is nudged onto its spacer joint so it reads as connected instead of hiding behind the head. Jaw now drops open downward instead of lifting up.

v7 changes: removed the extra ankle/foot pieces on legs 1/2/3/4 — each leg is just its base thigh piece again (already a complete hip-to-foot leg). The back-left leg was hiding its hip joint behind the head/body silhouette, so it's shifted right and brought in front, letting the spacer joint's own ball connect visibly to the leg instead of disappearing behind them. The jaw's open motion now swings down and out from its hinge instead of up into the head.
